2609.35643.title: Not All Thinking is Created Equal: Latent Reasoning Discovers a Recurrent Search Algorithm for Depth Generalization
2609.35643.paper_summary: Large Language Models can perform multi-step reasoning and improve task performance through different forms of intermediate computation, from token-based traces to computation carried out in latent space. However, a question remains open: do these different forms of thinking rely on the same underlying mechanism? To address this, we train and compare five variants of the same GPTNeoX backbone from scratch on an extended multi-hop reasoning task (ProsQA-Ext): a vanilla model, a Chain-of-Thought (CoT) model, a Pause Token model, and two latent-reasoning models that are optimized end-to-end without intermediate reasoning traces. We find that, strong in-distribution (ID) performance does not guarantee depth generalization. Vanilla, CoT, and Pause Token models solve ID problems well, but rely largely on local graph features and generalize poorly to out-of-distribution (OOD) problems with longer hops. In contrast, latent variants generalize better and show internal dynamics consistent with forward reachability propagation on the graph. Causal interventions and circuit analysis localize this computation to a sparse recurrent search circuit in the bottleneck latent model: an attention head retrieves graph relations, an MLP and the residual stream update the reachability state across recurrent steps, while multiple attention heads together then do the candidate matching. Together, these results show that different thinking mechanisms can learn distinct computational solutions, even at similar ID performance. In this setting, latent recurrence supports a reusable forward-search algorithm that generalizes beyond the training depth.
2609.35643.paper_summary_zh: 大型語言模型可以通過不同形式的中介計算來執行多步推理並改善任務表現，從基於標記的痕跡到在潛在空間中進行的計算。<lb/>然而，一個問題仍然懸而未決：這些不同形式的思維是否依賴於相同的基本機制？<lb/>為了解決這個問題，我們從頭開始訓練並比較五個相同GPTNeoX骨幹的變體，針對擴展的多跳推理任務（ProsQA-Ext）：一個普通模型、一個思維鏈（CoT）模型、一個暫停標記模型，以及兩個在沒有中介推理痕跡的情況下端到端優化的潛在推理模型。<lb/>我們發現，強大的內部分佈（ID）表現並不保證深度泛化。<lb/>普通、CoT和暫停標記模型在解決ID問題方面表現良好，但在很大程度上依賴於局部圖特徵，並且在處理更長跳躍的外部分佈（OOD）問題時泛化效果不佳。<lb/>相比之下，潛在變體的泛化效果更好，並顯示出與圖上的前向可達性傳播一致的內部動態。<lb/>因果干預和電路分析將這一計算定位於瓶頸潛在模型中的稀疏遞歸搜索電路：一個注意力頭檢索圖關係，一個MLP和殘差流在遞歸步驟中更新可達性狀態，而多個注意力頭則一起進行候選匹配。<lb/>綜合這些結果顯示，不同的思維機制可以學習不同的計算解決方案，即使在相似的ID表現下。<lb/>在這種情況下，潛在遞歸支持一種可重用的前向搜索算法，該算法的泛化超出了訓練深度。
